text:
75세 여성 환자 CHF exacerbation으로 입원함.

Vital Signs:
- BP 90/60 mmHg
- HR 110 bpm
- RR 22 breaths/min
- BT 36.8°C
- SpO2 88% on room air

Dyspnea moderate 호소함.

Furosemide 40 mg IV q8h 투여 중.

Oxygen support 2L nasal cannula 적용함.

Foley 유지함.

Positive fluid balance 확인됨.

환자 drowsy 상태 확인됨.

Cardiology team notify함.
